key_insight: BRIDGE provides paired prostate biopsy images across three preparation stages to support AI research in label-free virtual staining.
clinical_relevance: The dataset may help researchers evaluate computational staining and prostate cancer grading methods, but clinical utility is not established in the abstract.
method: Sequentially scan each slide in paraffin, after deparaffinization, and after H&E staining.
Pair whole-slide images with slide-level Gleason scores.
Provide de-identified images in native scanner format through the BioImage Archive.
evidence_signal: The single-center dataset contains 2,607 whole-slide images from 869 glass slides representing 169 patients; no AI performance results are reported in the abstract.
watch_item: Generalizability across institutions and scanners requires evaluation before clinical translation.
paper_title: The BRIDGE dataset: paired brightfield whole-slide images of prostate core-needle biopsies in paraffin, after deparaffinization and H&E staining
